The [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventures published in ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''{{#if:{{{1|}}}|, including "[[{{#switch:{{{1|}}}
  | The Politics of Contraband = The Politics of Contraband (adventure){{!}}The Politics of Contraband
  | The Art of Betrayal = The Art of Betrayal
  | Free Time = Free Time
  | The Right Place ... = The Right Place ...
  | Easy Money = Easy Money
  }}]],"}} are set in the [[New Republic era]] and before the events of ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''. {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}} and the [[Wookieepedia:The Star Wars Legends Novels Timeline|''Star Wars'' Legends Novels Timeline]] date the beginning of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' sets the events of ''Heir to the Empire'' in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<noinclude>
==Usage==
<pre><nowiki>{{ThePoliticsOfContrabandDate|title}}</nowiki></pre>
where {{Para|title}} is an optional roleplaying adventure title.
